resources.string: Only for me hides the message here. For everyone also saves a deletion to the outbox; the other side changes when it receives it.
Hiding a queued message does not cancel its send. It remains in the outbox.
Message hidden on this device. Its queued send is not cancelled.
Message unchanged. Current revision checked; no new edit queued.
Message removed here. Deletion for everyone saved · %1$s
Change saved. The connectivity attempt failed; retry the outbox.
Unable to verify the local change. Draft retained; new sends and message actions paused until the exact message is checked.
The message changed. Your edit draft is retained. Review it and tap Save again.
This message is unavailable for this action. Your edit draft is retained; it will not be sent as a new message.
Removed locally. Remote deletion has its own delivery status; retry uses the saved deletion.
